items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: I believe it was old man Gilmore's boy. I bought it off of him, a Christmas toy, in other words.

ctx.x: Oh, I muck with music before I started to play. Before I got married, you muck around a kid, you know, before I was married. I was already about 13 years old, so like that, when I started, you know. I had a drum. I believe it was old man Gilmore's boy. I bought it off of him, a Christmas toy, in other words. That was my first instrument. But the first good instrument came from the expedition. a field drum. They called it a field drum.
